effortNote: Unchanged but conditional: L only after F-t3-009 and F-t3-043 exist; building that substrate is separate and XL. Curated named profiles are M.
verdictReason: Absent and hard-blocked by two prerequisites that do not exist, with no demand evidence and a supply-chain risk; curated runtime profiles deliver most of the value sooner.

exactGap: None of the three proposed pieces exists: there is no persistent machine (leases are per run with a one-hour TTL, and background processes die with their parent and are capped at one hour), no execution-target concept on runs or in the composer, and no dev-server preview (HTML artifacts render only in a sandboxed srcdoc iframe, and the sandbox network namespace is down). The item's premise that files already persist per Space is only partly true: hydrate, the per-run overlay and the PromoteWorkspace compare-and-swap merge are built, but nothing calls promote_workspace (the execution-core client method at sandbox_manager_client.rs:314 has no caller and the Go handler no other consumer), so a later run never sees an earlier run's edits.

effortNote: Unchanged for the bundle; wiring promote is S to M and should be its own item, a human-facing preview is M, and a persistent machine is L to XL.
verdictReason: All three proposed pieces are absent and gated on F-t3-009, the item itself flags low demand confidence, and its file-persistence premise is overstated; the promote wiring should be pulled forward as a separate item.

exactGap: No rewind, side chat or spin-off exists in code: messages are a linear table with a sequence identity and no parent pointer (session-core 0001_init.sql:14-24), InvokeRequest.parent_message_id (gateway.proto:250) has no handler, checkpoints are run step watermarks (compaction.rs:1-12, save_checkpoint) with no restore RPC, and regenerate and edit versions are client-only (chat-versions.ts:1-12). Rewind is already planned as I10 then I11 in CHAT_GAP_CLOSURE_PLAN (lines 236, 252) with the owner recommendation of conversation plus artifact versions and effectful turns non-rewindable (OD19, line 509); side chat and spin-off appear in no plan, and today a message sent mid-run is queued into the running agent (QueuedInputStrip) instead of being answered separately.

constraints: ZDR: a side chat under a ZDR parent must not persist; threads.origin allows only chat, space, agent_run, support and system, so a persisted 'side' thread needs a migration, while an unpersisted ephemeral invocation avoids both problems. Space authority: a side chat inherits the parent's Space read decision and audience context and must never widen them. inline_tool_allowed is a denylist (save_memory, browser_agent, mcp tools) and still admits create_artifact, update_artifact, code_interpreter and reattach_skill, so it cannot serve as the read-only gate the item assumes. Rewind cannot undo provider writes or sandbox effects, so effectful turns stay non-rewindable per OD19; spin-off may only create a draft chip that a person accepts, never start effectful work.
approachAdjustment: Remove rewind from this item and reference I10 and I11 (planned, M, dependent on the server message tree). Keep side chat as the new recommendation, implemented in model-gateway as an ephemeral invocation with an explicit read-only tool allowlist (for example web_search, fetch_url, knowledge_search and its siblings, read_artifact, count_words, result_query) over a snapshot of the parent thread, with no persistence under ZDR; build spin-off last as a plan-gate-style draft chip.
effortNote: Rewind (M) is already in the plan; the remaining side chat (M) plus spin-off (S to M) is M overall.
verdictReason: All three are absent in code, but rewind is already planned and should be referenced rather than re-recommended; side chat is a genuine gap but its approach reuses an inline tool gate that is not read-only.
